description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `ServiceHandle` which encapsulates basic information about a service, intended for use in an inter-process communication and service registry context. It provides fields for service name, IPC port, event port, and visibility, along with constructors and getter methods. It also declares abstract methods related to process and host locality checks.

classes.name: ServiceHandle
classes.description: An abstract class representing a service's basic metadata used for IPC and remote invocation, including service name, ports, and visibility.

methods.name: ServiceHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service handle with name, IPC port, and event port, assuming local host visibility by default.

methods.name: ServiceHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service handle with name, IPC port, event port, and explicit visibility.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service.

methods.name: getIpcPort
methods.description: Returns the IPC port used by the service.

methods.name: getEventPort
methods.description: Returns the event port used by the service.

methods.name: getVisibility
methods.description: Returns the visibility setting of the service.

methods.name: isSameProcess
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the service is in the same process.

methods.name: isLocalHost
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the service runs on the same host.

methods.name: isRemoteHost
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the service runs on a different host.
